New to the Market – 3 Bedroom Detached Two-Storey Residence
Williamstown, Co. Galway

Guide Price: €105,000

Nigel Dineen & Martin Finn Auctioneers are delighted to bring to the market this 3-bedroom detached two-storey residence, ideally positioned at a prominent crossroads location in the heart of Williamstown.

While the property requires internal refurbishment, it presents an excellent opportunity for those seeking a renovation project or investment property in a well-connected and established rural town.

Accommodation Comprises:
Spacious entrance hallway with stairwell
Kitchen / dining area with fireplace
Under-stair storage
Three well-proportioned bedrooms
Main bathroom
Stira stairs to partially floored attic

Features Include:
Detached two-storey residence
Double glazed windows throughout
Strong potential for refurbishment and value enhancement
Prime central location within the town

Location Highlights:
Walking distance to local shop, church, filling station, public house and school
Approx. 10 minutes to Castlerea Town
Approx. 20 minutes to Tuam
Approx. 1 hour to Galway City

This property offers a fantastic opportunity to create a family home or investment property, with the benefit of a central and convenient location.

Viewing is highly recommended and strictly by appointment.
